visualCharacteristics.structure: tabs + unit toggle + accordion groups + label/value/unit rows

contentPattern: Single block, rows in order ; single-cell <h3> row = tab (Full specs, Standard equipment, Optional equipment; tabs render only when more than one) ; single-cell <h4> row = collapsible group in the current tab (first group open, Expand all / Close all) ; single-cell <h5> row = sub-group title ; data row: Label | Value | Units (imperial, metric or empty = always shown) ; equipment rows: Label empty or 'Equipment' | list content (bullets, sub-headings, footnotes) | Units ; each row is filtered by its own Units cell (no metric/imperial pairing) ; 'Specifications' H2 is default content above the block ; follows the shared unit preference (scripts/units.js) ; section style: white-container
